module: Zone boundary management for "crawl" mode (slow traversal). It spawns flags (TSStatic flagMarker.dae) along a zone's outline, animates them (appearing with scaling and fade, disappearing with fade) when an active crawler or the camera is within visibilityRadius meters, via a 2D quadtree, and checks whether a crawler has left the zone. An exit is recorded; if the crawler moves at least 10 m away from the exit point (all corners outside), the 'dnf' penalty is applied only once via gameplay_crawl_utils.applyPenalty; otherwise onBoundaryViolation is called.
notes: Distances in meters, animation durations in seconds. Default values: visibilityRadius 100, animationDuration 0.5, fadeIn 0.3, fadeOut 0.2, scaleUp 0.4, scale from 0.1 to 1.0.
Probable bug: setVisibilityRadius(nil) resets to 200 while the initial value is 100.
Probable bug: getQuadtreeStats and the buildBoundaryQuadtree log use #boundaryObjects; boundaryObjects is keyed by object id (not a sequence), so # can be 0 or a wrong value.
checkBoundary calls gameplay_crawl_utils.onBoundaryViolation without testing that gameplay_crawl_utils exists in some branches (error if the module is not loaded).
In checkBoundary, without available corners (currentCorners empty), the bbCenter position is tested with site:containsPoint2D; returns true as long as the crawler is not disqualified.
A marker is only placed if the terrain normal has a dot product >= 0.5 with the Z axis.
The marker objects are in a 'BoundaryMarkers' SimGroup added to MissionGroup, with canSave = false.

updateBoundaryAnimations.desc: Updates the visibility and animation of the boundary flags: those close to an active crawler (or to the camera if none is active) appear, the others disappear. To be called every frame.

resetBoundaryObjects.desc: Hides all tracked flags (hidden, minimum scale, transparent color) then empties the tracking table.

spawnBoundaryMarkers.desc: Removes the previous markers, then creates flags along the outline (one every spacing meters, placed on the terrain and oriented along the segment) and builds the visibility quadtree. The flags start hidden.

boundary.desc: Outline with vertices (at least 3), each with pos (vec3) and optionally next.

spacing.desc: Distance between flags in meters (2.0 by default).

returns.desc: Id of the markers SimGroup; nil if the outline is invalid.

cleanupBoundaryMarkers.desc: Deletes the markers group and empties the tracking.

checkBoundary.desc: Tests whether a crawler is in the zone (vehicle corners or center of its box). Records the exit point, applies the 'dnf' penalty (once) if all corners are outside at 10 m or more from the exit point, or reports a boundary violation.

crawlStates.desc: Crawler states keyed by id (active field).

returns.desc: false if the crawler is inactive, disqualified (DNF) or if no site is given; true otherwise.

setVisibilityRadius.desc: Sets the radius (m) within which the flags are visible.

setAnimationTiming.desc: Sets the flags' animation durations (default values if nil).

rebuildQuadtree.desc: Rebuilds the quadtree from the tracked flags (useful if these objects change).

getQuadtreeStats.desc: Returns the quadtree state for debug.

triggerAppearingAnimation.desc: Restarts the appearance animation for the flags that are currently not hidden.

getCrawlerExitPoint.desc: Returns the point where the crawler left the zone.

returns.desc: Exit point, or nil if the crawler is in the zone.

clearCrawlerExitPoint.desc: Clears a crawler's exit point and DNF flag.

clearAllExitPoints.desc: Clears all exit points and DNF flags.
